pr_title: On windows, recreate renderer swap chain on restore from minimized
pr_body:
Closes #21688

Release Notes:

- Windows: Fix freeze after window minimize and maximize
pr_comments:
I can confirm this works in my machine well 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/603e27b3-6c8c-45a2-8c69-71c1bece5319

It works on my machine, but generate some warning logs `Acquire failed because the surface is out of date`,  the app still try render after minimized? 

![freeze1210](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3e89e4a1-c871-4d21-94db-6aac7b48e958)

Going to go ahead and merge since the fix is working.  Can refine from here.

issue_context.title: On windows, the app crashes when I minimize it
issue_context.body:
### Check for existing issues

- [x] Completed

### Describe the bug / provide steps to reproduce it

If I just switch to another application, then when I return to zed, it continues to function, but if I minimize it and expand it, it stops responding to any actions other than the window control buttons.
If I expand it to full screen (using the window control button at the top of the zed window), it will start functioning again.
If i collapse it again, everything will repeat itself.

### Environment

Windows 11 24H2   
AMD Ryzen 2700 Eight-Core (x64)
16gb ram
I have compiled zed from the source code   
I have not installed any plugins on it

### If applicable, attach your `~/Library/Logs/Zed/Zed.log` file to this issue.

<details><summary>Zed.log</summary>
```
[Zed.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18049222/Zed.log)
```
</details>
